why: Every route renders inside the frame.
what: The v3 root route, login, app shell, nav, commands, auth gate, error boundary, router, notifications, main.tsx, the upstream decision and schedule-row components and the private finance history module.
contract: Read basalt-ui docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.1-6.3, argo DESIGN.md and the managed layer (.claude/rules/basalt-v3-*.md, skills basalt-v3-*). The installed basalt-ui is exact 3.0.0-next.N: its docs/recipes and llms.txt are the API truth. Never import apps/dashboard; share through @argo/shared. Order: shared, state-features, state-stores, queries, shell, routes; an import from a later Issue is a signal, never a stub. Shell law: docs/v3/concepts/shell-nav-router.md (AppShell, defineNav, routerDefaults, RouteError/RouteMissing/RoutePending seeds, ToastHost, OverlayHost). eden, auth, shot-state: state-stores; queries: v3-argo-queries. *.module.css are not ported.
change: Root route with BasaltProvider (locale from @argo/shared APP_LOCALE), AppShell and defineNav (sections, pinned, mobile, badges from use-sidebar-badges and use-sidebar-blocks), router via routerDefaults (basepath /v3, the old 401 handling), login route, auth gate, defineCommands for the palette, notifications over notify, upstream decision-card and schedule-row, timer-nav, main.tsx (replaces the stub), private-history kept in the router config, and lib/format-locale.test.ts (createFormat for the app locale, replacing the dropped defineFormat test). Rule: shell guard rules (primitive-bypass frame check) pass in the app preset.
commits: Argo ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body, worked around in app code.
proof: `make design-shot APP=dashboard-v3 ROUTES="/"` beside the old shots from APP=dashboard; basalt-design reviewer; 3 rounds max.
acceptance: `make check` exits 0 (runs check-v3: sync --check, doctor, lint, typecheck, build, test)
`bun scripts/check-test-port.ts apps/dashboard/src/components/upstream apps/dashboard-v3/src/components/upstream` and for commands.test.ts exit 0 (changed lines carry `// port:` markers)
`make design-shot APP=dashboard-v3 ROUTES="/"` writes 1440x900 and 390x844 shots against live data (the reviewer checks 390 for horizontal overflow; DOM tests cannot)
`make verify-pages BASE=http://127.0.0.1:7737/v3 ROUTES=/` reports PASS after the factory deploy (else state not-run)
a DOM test through renderApp: with a valid token `/login` redirects to `/`, with none `/` redirects to login with the redirect search param
out_of_scope: Any feature route, nav beyond placeholders, API changes.
